CONTROLLER SWITCH

REM Take and hatch eggs from the daycare in Pokemon Brilliant Diamond or Shining Pearl.

REM A certain setup is required to execute this script successfully. Please read the following instructions carefully.

REM In the game options, set Text Speed to 'Fast' and Autosave to 'Off'.

Have the step counter app loaded on your Poketch all zeroed out.

REM Have the Oval Charm.

REM Go to Solaceon Town and deposit the two Pokemon you want to breed into the daycare on the west side of town. Ensure they are compatible species for breeding.
REM Here is a good guide on how to optimally breed pokemon: https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_breeding
REM If you are shiny hunting, it is beneficial to have the shiny charm and a foreign Pokemon to breed with. More info here: https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Shiny_Pok%C3%A9mon

REM Empty your party except for 1 Pokemon with the Flame Body ability. Slugma or Magcargo are good candidates in this game.

REM Assign the Bike to the left (western) key item slot. Ensure it is already in 'fast' mode by pressing B while riding it.

REM Run around and wait for the old man outside the daycare to face east. This means an egg is ready.

REM Face the old man from his right (east) side so that pressing A will talk to him.

PRESS R

REPEAT START

REM Talk to the old man to receive an egg
REPEAT START 6
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
REPEAT END
DELAY 3000
PRESS A
DELAY 500
PRESS A
REPEAT START 2
DELAY 2000
PRESS A
PRESS A
REPEAT END
DELAY 200
REM Have this bit for when the party gets full and you must replace a Pokemon
PRESS UP
REPEAT START 2
DELAY 2000
PRESS A
REPEAT END
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 500
PRESS A
DELAY 500


REM Fly to Pokecenter in Solaceon Town
PRESS X
DELAY 1000
PRESS PLUS
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 6200

REM Head north of Solaceon Town
PUSH B
PUSH LEFT
DELAY 1340
RELEASE LEFT
PUSH UP
DELAY 3000
RELEASE ALL
PUSH LEFT
DELAY 200
RELEASE LEFT
PRESS RIGHT
DELAY 500

REM Get on bicycle
PRESS PLUS
DELAY 500
PRESS LEFT
DELAY 1000

REM Ride in circles. Adjust the 'REPEAT START' value to increase/decrease duration. 1 loop = approx 50 in-game steps
PUSH RIGHT
DELAY 900
REPEAT START 85
RELEASE RIGHT
PUSH DOWN
DELAY 420
RELEASE DOWN
PUSH LEFT
DELAY 420
RELEASE LEFT
PUSH UP
DELAY 425
RELEASE UP
PUSH RIGHT
DELAY 420
RELEASE RIGHT
PUSH DOWN
DELAY 424
RELEASE DOWN
PUSH LEFT
DELAY 420
RELEASE LEFT
PUSH UP
DELAY 420
RELEASE UP
PUSH RIGHT
DELAY 420
REPEAT END

RELEASE ALL

REM Egg is hatching
PRESS A
DELAY 500
PRESS A
DELAY 22000
PRESS A
DELAY 2000
PRESS B
DELAY 4000

REM Fly to Pokecenter in Solaceon Town
PUSH DOWN
DELAY 2000
RELEASE ALL
PRESS X
DELAY 1000
PRESS PLUS
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 6200

REM Head north back to the old man
PUSH B
PUSH LEFT
DELAY 1340
RELEASE LEFT
PUSH UP
DELAY 1250
RELEASE ALL
PUSH LEFT
DELAY 120
RELEASE ALL

REM Repeat the whole thing to hatch another egg
REPEAT END
